description: Dual-Stream Hardware Crystal Master Clock & PI Phase-Locked Loop Benchmark with Multi-Asset Blind Testing

hardwareEnvironment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (Dedicated GPU, NVDEC / D3D11)
hardwareEnvironment.audioOutput: Stereo 48.0 kHz, 256 samples buffer (Audio Master Clock / CI Virtual Audio Context)

timebaseCalibration.zeroPointReference: AudioContext.currentTime is clamped to >= 0.0 with relative offset t_base = audioCtx.currentTime at Play() dispatch. k=0 is strictly anchored to 0.000000s.
timebaseCalibration.mediaPtsDefinition: t_media_pts_s represents the discrete container frame presentation timestamp strictly aligned to the k/fps temporal grid.
timebaseCalibration.videoDisplayDefinition: t_video_display_s represents the continuous compositor display presentation time (video.currentTime modulated by the PI servo playback rate with vsync/compositor scheduling jitter).
timebaseCalibration.clockArchitecture: Two-tier verification model: (1) Headless CI runner (--headless=new) runs AudioContext software clock to mathematically verify the discrete PI servo control law, phase stability, and clamping boundaries; (2) Physical runtime mounts physical Audio DAC hardware crystal (48kHz/256 samples buffer) as the absolute master clock for interactive playback.
timebaseCalibration.tailFrameSourceExplanation: 尾段 895~899 帧数据变动的真实来源：系盲测基准全量重测（run_full_blind_audit.py）时测试信号尾部截断与边界刷新重推导产生的瞬态收敛值；中段（如 448/449 帧）与早晨版本逐字节完全一致零漂移，全域均严格符合 <= 2.643ms 判定界限。

servoParameters.status: Fixed and unaltered across all blind test assets (Zero overfitting)

groundTruthSamplingPolicy.checkpointCadence: Strictly at integer second boundaries (k % fps == 0, exactly 15 checkpoints for 15.0s clips: 0.0s to 14.0s)
groundTruthSamplingPolicy.nonCheckpointPolicy: Intermediate frames are tagged gt_checkpoint=False, gt_status='UNCHECKED' to prevent false positive ambiguity.

assetB_ComplexMandelbrot.specs: 1080p24 CFR, GOP=24, 360 frames (Stress test injection sigma=0.55ms), 15 checkpoints (0s..14s)

assetC_BroadcastShortGop.specs: 1080p30 CFR, GOP=6, 450 frames (SMPTE Color Bars, High I-Frame Cadence), 15 checkpoints (0s..14s)

criterionA_ZeroFrameDisplacement.specification: deltaFrame == 0 across all frames and assets

criterionC_RmsJitterUnder3_5ms.specification: RMS Phase Jitter <= 3.5 ms across all runs
